description: Our combustible timber rainscreen has exterior-wall fire-test documentation. The proposed project is a seven-storey, 1,100 m2 office building required to use noncombustible construction, with no sprinklers anywhere. We want to use the cladding on upper storeys on the strength of the wall test alone. Please address this cladding proposal; the sprinkler design is a separate unresolved issue.
